name: Nakama Authoritative Tic-Tac-Toe
overview: Built a server-authoritative multiplayer game to explore realtime systems, distributed state management, and authoritative game-server architecture. The server owns and validates gameplay state while the client focuses on presentation and interaction.
challenge: Design a multiplayer architecture where the server remains the source of truth for gameplay while handling realtime synchronization, matchmaking, disconnects, reconnections, and concurrent matches.
projectDetails: Engineered server-authoritative gameplay with game logic executed and validated on the Nakama server.
Implemented matchmaking, match lifecycle management, and realtime state synchronization.
Designed connection handling for player joins, disconnects, reconnections, and match recovery.
Integrated the React frontend with the Nakama client SDK for realtime multiplayer interactions.
Implemented deterministic move validation to prevent invalid or conflicting game states.
Maintained isolated state for concurrent authoritative matches.
Implemented timed turns, leaderboard progression, and persistent match history.
Containerized the backend with Docker and deployed the server infrastructure using Railway.
outcome: Built a complete multiplayer architecture where gameplay state and validation are owned by the authoritative server rather than trusted to the client.

name: iSee – Video Calling Platform
overview: Built a peer-to-peer video communication platform for instant browser-based conversations without requiring user registration. The product combines WebRTC media communication, Socket.io signaling, realtime messaging, and room-based sessions.
challenge: Build a frictionless realtime communication experience that establishes peer connections without accounts while handling signaling, media sessions, room management, messaging, and connection lifecycle events.
projectDetails: Built peer-to-peer video communication using WebRTC.
Implemented Socket.io signaling for session negotiation and peer connection management.
Designed instant room creation using unique session codes without requiring user accounts.
Developed realtime messaging alongside live video communication.
Handled connection lifecycle events to improve session stability and recovery.
Built a responsive communication interface for desktop and mobile devices.
outcome: Created a browser-based video communication workflow that establishes peer-to-peer sessions through room codes without requiring account registration.

name: Veyra – Biotech Landing Page
overview: Built an animation-driven responsive landing page combining reusable React components, accessible navigation, responsive layouts, and sophisticated motion while keeping client-side interaction performant.
challenge: Create a visually rich landing page with sophisticated scroll and interaction effects while maintaining responsive behavior, accessibility, reduced-motion support, and efficient client-side rendering.
projectDetails: Built a responsive landing page using reusable React components and Next.js.
Implemented scroll-driven interaction and animation choreography using Framer Motion and GSAP.
Designed accessible navigation and interaction patterns across responsive breakpoints.
Added reduced-motion support for users who prefer limited animation.
Kept high-frequency interactions performant by minimizing unnecessary client-side state.
Structured the interface into reusable sections to support maintainable product development.

name: JustSocial – Social Media Platform
overview: Built a full-stack social networking platform covering authentication, profiles, relationships, content feeds, realtime messaging, notifications, and community interactions. The project demonstrates end-to-end product engineering across the client, server, data layer, and realtime communication.
challenge: Build a cohesive social product combining dynamic content, user relationships, realtime communication, authentication, and responsive interfaces while keeping the application structured for continued feature development.
projectDetails: Engineered a full-stack application using React, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
Implemented realtime messaging and notifications using WebSockets.
Built dynamic content feeds supporting posts, comments, likes, and other user interactions.
Designed user relationship management including friend requests, connections, and profile management.
Implemented authentication, authorization, and secure session handling.
Developed responsive interfaces using Material UI across desktop and mobile devices.
Structured frontend and backend functionality to support maintainable feature development.
